verdicts.decision_note: The message is explicitly a freelancer-proposed milestone plan, and the supplied client context does not accept Apollo enrichment as a product requirement.
The client uniquely accepts the proposed workflow in which Apollo automatically enriches saved leads with email information before export to HubSpot; no obsolete prior attribute requires removal.
This is the first concrete verification with counts for both paths: 44 contacts were automatically enriched and transferred, while the 76 contacts still lacking email were manually uploaded.
